subject: vertical position of text in the axis

messages.author: 0600694caf57b8fb
messages.subject: vertical position of text in the axis
parts:
Hello,

I want to plot the text in the x-axis closer to the ticks, but vjust
does not work for me:

qplot(carat, price, data = diamonds)
+opts(axis.text.x=(theme_text(vjust=1)))


I have no problems to move the text in the horizontal direction with
hjust:

qplot(carat, price, data = diamonds)
+opts(axis.text.x=(theme_text(hjust=1)))

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: vertical position of text in the axis
parts:
Hi,

At this time (and also in the next version), that is impossible.
Please note that "justification" is working, but the way is not what
you expect, try this:

df <- data.frame(x=c("a", "b\nc", "d"), y=1:3)

qplot(x, y, data = df) + opts(axis.text.x=(theme_text(vjust=0)))
qplot(x, y, data = df) + opts(axis.text.x=(theme_text(vjust=0.5)))
qplot(x, y, data = df) + opts(axis.text.x=(theme_text(vjust=1)))
